summary: Six distinct operating sponsors qualify out of 20 base records. Ranked by qualifying transaction date descending then size descending: Birch Point 6 Capital ($13,200,000; 2026-07-10), Birch Park 5 Capital ($12,480,000; 2026-06-09, email null), Birch Square 4 Capital ($11,760,000; 2026-05-08, unsigned $48M draft rejected), Birch Park 3 Capital ($11,040,000; 2026-04-07, post-cutoff 'former' update rejected), Birch Square 2 Capital ($10,320,000; 2026-03-06, contact replaced by controlling 2026-08-20 team page), and Birch Square 1 Capital ($9,600,000; 2026-02-05, one slot covering duplicate R2431 and SPV R2005). Fourteen records were excluded for portfolio-total basis, broker/property-manager firm kind, wrong market or asset type, out-of-window or post-cutoff publication, announced-bid status, sub-threshold size, stale contact verification, former employment, or registered-agent-only contact. No fabricated emails were added; Birch Park 5 Capital's email is an explicit null.
limitations: Artifact generation (comp-grid XLSX / prospect CSV) is outside this direct API control; no workbook or CSV was produced or delivered. The selected facts above are the intended file contents.

For entity BIRCH-SPO-59032 the sponsor slot is reported using the parent's own record R1077 ($9,600,000 on 2026-02-05); the SPV-level transaction in R2005 ($13,920,000 on 2026-02-11) maps to the same parent and would change the ranking position if the parent were instead represented by its SPV acquisition.

R1638 (Birch Park 3 Capital) is at risk: U-R1638-2 marks the CFO as former effective 2026-09-10. It is excluded as later-dated evidence relative to the 2026-08-31 cutoff, but the contact is likely stale for outreach after that date.
R9716 (Birch Grove 18 Capital) appears to meet all substantive criteria but its only source was published 2026-09-03, after the cutoff; it could qualify if pre-cutoff evidence exists.
R6206 may involve a qualifying single-asset purchase within the portfolio total of $84,000,000, but no per-asset allocation is evidenced; treated as missing, not zero.
No independent confirmation of transaction sizes, closing status or officer titles beyond the supplied extracts and updates; verification dates are as-published and not re-confirmed.
Distance_miles values were not used as a screening criterion since no radius was specified in the brief.
